_doc: Project settings of spec-first-kit. setup.mjs adds new keys and never changes your values. Commands are filled by /onboard from commands that were actually run: typecheck and tests feed the stop gate (use quiet reporters; tests = the full unit suite), lint and build join them in doctor --full, the one baseline run. format runs after every file edit, {file} is the edited path (e.g. "npx prettier --write --ignore-unknown {file}"); empty = off. formatScope: all | new; "new" formats only files with no committed version, for a repo whose committed code the formatter would still change. stopGate: off | typecheck | tests. stopGateRetries: how many times the gate may block one stop sequence. testFiles: a regular expression for test file paths, only when trace.mjs does not find the tests by name (empty = built-in patterns). packages: in a monorepo, the folders where people start Claude Code ("packages/*" = every folder under packages/); sync.mjs gives each a .claude/settings.json that runs the root hooks. guardRules: shell commands guard.mjs blocks for this project, each { "pattern": <JavaScript regular expression tested against the whole command, case-insensitive>, "why": <the reason the agent sees> }, e.g. { "pattern": "\\bterraform\\s+apply\\b", "why": "applying infrastructure changes" }. codex: true when anyone uses Codex here; switch it with setup.mjs --codex or --no-codex.
